constraints: Cannot be executed in compiled mode; doing so generates error -9762.
When called from a component you must pass the trailing '*' parameter, because component code is normally read-only; if you omit '*' in that context, error -9763 is generated.

jointConstraints.rule: attribValue must be a Text (a folder name) only when attribType is the 'Attribute folder name' constant (1024); for every other attribType constant, attribValue must be a Boolean (True to select the option, False to deselect it). The same rule applies to each repeated attribType/attribValue pair.
